name: startup-business-plan
description: Integrated, assumption-led startup business plans for Vera from reviewed evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Build an integrated, reviewable startup business plan.
interface.longDescription: Vera prepares one integrated business-plan case for a startup or new venture, including pre-revenue and early-revenue stages. Pilot evidence and early actuals are used when they exist; otherwise the plan starts from explicitly confirmed opening facts, available funding, and assumptions. Exact P&L, cash-flow, balance-sheet, scenario, funding and reconciliation calculations remain separate from model-led interpretation and professional approval. Established-company strategic planning is outside this workflow.
defaultPrompt: Prepare an integrated startup business plan from this evidence and my assumptions.
Show the evidence gaps and assumption ledger before calculating.
Reconcile the forecast P&L, cash flow, balance sheet, and funding requirement.
